prediction.keyboardOwner: wireComboboxes on the current picker host
prediction.rationale: The badge bindings read the active outgoing count. Each ID keeps its mounted row and editor across refetch and swap. If moving the row blurs the editor, the reorder restores focus and selection before returning. Selection updates the affected aria-selected bindings directly, so it does not construct row JSX. Each open wires one picker host, and close disposes that wiring before removing the host.
